theorems.name: Submission.cmcdt_lpo_cyl_current
theorems.statement: (∀ (N k : ℕ) (X : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid N)) k) (ψ : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid N)) k) (c : ℝ), X.mass < ∞ → (∀ x ∈ X.support, covectorEuclideanNorm ((ψ : DifferentialForm (Euclid N) k) x) ≤ c) → |X ψ| ≤ c * X.mass.toReal) → (∀ (N k : ℕ) (T₀ : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid N)) k →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) (C : ℝ), (∀ (ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid N)) k) (c : ℝ), (∀ x, covectorEuclideanNorm ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid N) k) x) ≤ c) → |T₀ ω| ≤ C * c) → ∃ T : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid N)) k, (∀ ω, T ω = T₀ ω) ∧ T.mass ≤ ENNReal.ofReal C) → ∀ (N k : ℕ) (S : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid (N + 1))) (k + 1) →ₗ[ℝ] TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid N)) k), (∀ (ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid (N + 1))) (k + 1)) (c : ℝ), (∀ y : Euclid (N + 1), covectorEuclideanNorm ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid (N + 1)) (k + 1)) y) ≤ c) → ∀ x : Euclid N, covectorEuclideanNorm ((S ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid N) k) x) ≤ c) → ∃ cyl : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid N)) k → GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid (N + 1))) (k + 1), (∀ X : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid N)) k, X.mass < ∞ → (∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid (N + 1))) (k + 1), cyl X ω = X (S ω)) ∧ (cyl X).mass ≤ X.mass) ∧ ∀ X Y : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid N)) k, X.mass < ∞ → Y.mass < ∞ → cyl (X - Y) = cyl X - cyl Y
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
